jobPostingInfo.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Acme runs the payment rails for small shops across the region. We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to keep them up.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Run Kubernetes clusters on two clouds.

  • Own the on-call rotation and the postmortems.

What We Need to See:

  • 5+ years operating Linux services in production.

  • Terraform and Go.
